synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 6 (A1-4), blocked by board edges, the HUD band (y<8), or any wall pixel in the destination box unless that box holds the plate centre. The first input of a fresh level (counter w=64) is a no-op.
Counter (the hypothesis): it loses 1px only on odd-numbered calls, so the hidden thing is the action-count parity n. n is gated on continuity; when a state breaks the chain, fall back to n=0 if w=64, else n=2*(64-w)-1 (odd).
Wall: the plate is the topmost 3x3 square. When the player or ghost covers it, wall pixels left of the main column shift +6 toward it (clipped), and layer-1 boxes crop wall pixels. The unpressed wall template is cached and only refreshed from frames with at least as many wall pixels as the cache.
A5 off spawn: with no ghost it records (red hud at (1,1), other huds x+4, trail=[level start, spawn]); with a ghost it clears it. Both respawn the player. Names are type_{list index:03d}.
Step-43 mechanic: the ghost is the player trail lagged 2 moves and is not ext
